criteria_origin: Post-observation diagnostic scope; not predeclared design acceptance limits.
rationale: Sub-picosecond edge disagreement and millivolt output disagreement are small relative to observed multi-cycle gaps exceeding800ps. Identical counts and ordinal matching support reproducing that severe output symptom, not all internal dynamics.
allowed: Locate candidate mechanisms for the reproduced multi-cycle LO output failure.
Compare candidate circuits against this exact replay baseline as a screening experiment.
excluded: Direct validation of MID/PRE: parent did not record these nodes.
All-node identity: LNA gate difference reaches1.431mV.
Noise, phase noise, startup, autonomous feedback/loading or receiver sensitivity qualification.
Acceptance of a repair without restoring the autonomous connected simulation.
